description: A noise source and a rough oscillator in one: a triangle crossfaded with a randomly scaled sawtooth, usable as an LFO, a dirty oscillator or a noise source

params.text: Sets the rate, from well below a hertz up into the audio range
Attenuates and inverts the rate jack before it is added to the rate, each volt doubling or halving it
Scales the output, from silence at the bottom to full at the top
Adds a direct voltage to the output; the knob reads from -1 to 1 but every unit is 5V at the jack, so it shifts the output by up to ±5V

inputs.text: Sets the rate exponentially, a volt doubling it; a polyphonic cable here gives each channel its own rate

outputs.text: The triangle and the randomised sawtooth mixed, seven parts triangle to three of saw, scaled and offset by the two trimmers

notes: the sawtooth is multiplied by a fresh random number every sample, which is where the noise comes from; at low rates it reads as noise that swells and fades, at high rates as a dirty oscillator
it runs as soon as it is added to a patch, with no clock or gate needed
the maker warns that feeding more than about three channels into the rate jack can crash Rack
